# Version 4.159.0 (Unreleased)
> **Image comparison and rendering fixes**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.159 introduces an experimental image-comparison package for testing rendered output. The upcoming release also adjusts Ganesh texture-edge sampling and Tizen CPU blur selection. Linux x86 native assets will no longer be included.

## Breaking Changes

- **Move Linux x86 deployments to a supported architecture** — Linux x86 native assets will no longer be included in NuGet packages, following upstream .NET's removal of Linux x86 cross-build infrastructure. Move 32-bit x86 Linux deployments to a supported architecture before upgrading. ([#5784](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5784))

## API Surface

- **Experimental image-comparison package** — SkiaSharp.Testing adds SKImageComparison for images, bitmaps and pixmaps, with channel tolerances, masks, mismatch budgets, error metrics and difference images. The separately packaged assembly is experimental: opt in by suppressing SKIA4001 with NoWarn or a pragma. Comparison results retain no native handles; returned difference images belong to the caller. ([#5293](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5293))

## Bug Fixes

- **Keep filtered texture samples inside subset edges** — Ganesh bilinear texture sampling now clamps slightly inward to avoid including undefined texels outside a subset. Texture-edge pixels may change; CPU and Graphite rendering are unaffected. ([#5679](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5679))
- **Apply Tizen CPU blur selection** — Tizen now applies its intended blur configuration to Skia itself, selecting the existing ThreeBoxApprox/Tent path instead of the shader-based Gaussian candidate. Blur pixels and performance may differ; Tizen rendering and performance were not measured locally. ([#5679](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5679))
